The IEEE standards mapped at category level in the Eticas taxonomy are:

1. IEEE Std 7001-2021 - covers Transparency and Explainability.
2. IEEE Std 7002-2022 - covers Privacy and Confidentiality.
3. IEEE Std 7003-2024 - covers Bias and Fairness.
4. IEEE Std 2894-2024 - covers Transparency and Explainability (advisory).

These standards are placed in the compliance tier of the taxonomy.
